name: sc-warfare-te-activate
description: Thunder's Edge Warfare primary by Mahact (pbd28 r1) with 0 tactic tokens (as Yssaril in playtest 7, pbd436), straight to the tactical action without redistributing first: 'Perform Tactical Action' closes the before-the-action Redistribute offer (it is offered again once the Warfare action ends), so the open decision is tactical.activate — answerable without a tactic token (its values carry token:false) — and no choose.confirm is left in front of it. Activating Mecatol Rex then opens movement and spends no token.
